recommendation: Keep the external-repo audit commit. Follow up in the OO Incubator repository to update DeviceUsage root description/definition and generated narrative so they no longer imply reports are limited to the patient or a clinician.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive with Modification issue for DSTU1 asking DeviceUseStatement to recognize reports from caregivers or family members, not only the patient or clinician, and to add source capture as Reference(Patient | Practitioner | RelatedPerson).
initial_application: Historical commit 7b5836fd63cc872ea63d2083105ae4297a174408 applied the issue by adding DeviceUseStatement.source and updating DeviceUseStatement introduction text to mention patient, provider, or related person reports. Later DeviceUsage refactors preserved the reporter element as DeviceUsage.informationSource.
additional_context: Later DeviceUsage issues refined the same area: FHIR-41413 added Group for family/household care and FHIR-48918 declined adding Device while clarifying patient-reported or second-hand reporting. Those related issues are already represented on the combined branch. Commit 3b38b80cf23f9cbb306fab8fcedb293315478c32 removed DeviceUsage from active core registration and changed core module links to the OO Incubator IG.
reconciliation: No core source was changed. The inactive local DeviceUsage StructureDefinition still has stale root patient-or-clinician wording, and the current OO Incubator JSON shows the same root wording while informationSource targets include RelatedPerson, Organization, and Group; however, the current source-of-truth for DeviceUsage is outside this FHIR core checkout.

related_jiras.note: Added Group support for DeviceUsage.subject and DeviceUsage.informationSource for family/household care; already represented on the combined branch as an external-repo audit.
Considered adding Device to DeviceUsage.informationSource but resolved by clarifying DeviceUsage scope without adding Device; already represented on the combined branch as an external-repo audit.
Added DeviceUsage workflow mappings including informationSource to Event.reported[x]; already represented on the combined branch as an external-repo audit.
Accepted pre-applied DeviceUsage post-updates after DeviceUseStatement refactors and does not change the reporter-source conclusion.
